newsitem.title: USA: Saga to buy two Wisconsin radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Saga to buy two Wisconsin radio stations.

text.p: Saga Communications Inc said Tuesday it entered into a letter of intent to acquire two Wisconsin radio stations for a total price of $5 million.

Saga plans to buys WFMR FM and WFMI FM from Harris Classical Broadcasting Co and Harbish Co, respectively. The transaction is subject to the completion of a definitive purchase agreement and approval by the Federal Communications Commission.
When the acquisition is completed, the two stations will join Saga's current Milwaukee stations, WKLH FM and WLZR AM/FM.
